content:
<thought>First, retrieve polymorph data for a representative set of oxide compositions using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the specified energy and count limits, storing the results in a dedicated directory.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": ["TiO2", "SiO2", "Al2O3", "Fe2O3", "FeO", "MgO", "CaO", "ZnO", "CuO", "NiO"],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}</action_input>
